nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of each account.
Public string token name 'FGRE_Portfolio_III_883'.
Public string token symbol 'FGRE883III'.
Public uint8 number of decimals, set to 18.
Public uint256 total token supply, 26619797430723400000000000000.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of approved spending allowances.
Constructor that assigns the entire totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' after a balance require check.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that moves tokens using the caller's allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the contract.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value; unchecked subtraction on sender balance in transfer.
balanceOf[to] += value; unchecked addition to recipient balance in transfer.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value; unchecked subtraction of the approved allowance.
balanceOf[from] -= value; unchecked subtraction from the source balance in transferFrom.
balanceOf[to] += value; unchecked addition to the destination balance in transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, destination address of the tokens.
Parameter 'value' of transfer, amount of tokens to move.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, the address gaining the allowance.
Parameter 'value' of approve, the allowance amount granted.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, source address of the tokens.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, destination address of the tokens.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom, amount of tokens to move.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender (untrusted caller) to mint the whole supply to the deployer, making supply ownership caller-dependent.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account, so authorization depends on the untrusted caller address.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] using the untrusted caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom consumes allowance[from][msg.sender], making the caller address a security-critical input.
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance.
transfer computes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transfer computes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom computes the unchecked subtraction of the allowance.
transferFrom computes the unchecked subtraction of the source balance.
transferFrom computes the unchecked addition to the destination balance.
approve writes the allowance mapping entry for msg.sender and spender.
Subtraction operation updates the balanceOf mapping for the sender.
Addition operation updates the balanceOf mapping for the recipient.
Allowance subtraction updates the allowance mapping.
Source balance subtraction updates balanceOf[from].
Destination balance addition updates balanceOf[to].
transfer parameter 'to' indexes the balance credited by the addition operation.
transfer parameter 'value' is the operand of the sender balance subtraction.
approve parameter 'spender' indexes the allowance mapping key.
approve parameter 'value' is the allowance amount written to storage.
transferFrom parameter 'from' indexes the balance that is debited.
transferFrom parameter 'from' indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented.
transferFrom parameter 'to' indexes the balance that is credited.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is the operand of the source balance subtraction.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is the operand of the destination balance addition.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is the operand of the allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' of transfer only serves to index the recipient balance credited by the transfer_credit unsafe operation.
Parameter 'value' of transfer only serves as the operand of the transfer_deduct unsafe operation.
Parameter 'spender' of approve only serves as the spender key written by the approve function.
Parameter 'value' of approve only serves as the amount written into allowance by the approve function.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom only serves to index the balance debited by the transferFrom_deduct unsafe operation.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom only serves to index the balance credited by the transferFrom_credit unsafe operation.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom is the amount used by the transferFrom_deduct unsafe operation before being propagated to allowance and destination updates.
